name: Calcutta Horse Race
description: Horse Race: gambling card game for 3+ players. Four Aces are horses; dealer turns cards by suit and each Ace moves. Players bet on which Ace wins. Calcutta variant: auction horses then race; first and second share pool.

overview.description: Horse Race: gambling card game for 3+ players. Four Aces are horses; dealer turns cards by suit and each Ace moves. Players bet on which Ace wins. Calcutta variant: auction horses then race; first and second share pool.

history.origins: Gambling game; Aces race by suit. Calcutta variant from Melbourne Cup-style auctions.

setup.deck: 52 cards; four Aces as horses; 7 cards form course.
setup.dealing: 7 cards face up as course; redeal if 5+ same suit.

rules.objective: Bet on which Ace (suit) wins. Calcutta: auction horses; first gets 2/3 of pool, second 1/3.
rules.gameplay: 1. Lay 7 cards face up as course (redeal if 5+ same suit). 2. Dealer turns cards one by one; each card advances that suit's Ace. 3. First Ace to reach 8 of its suit wins. 4. Calcutta: auction horses before race; 2/3 to first, 1/3 to second.
